question: Which app did I use to track my runs before I switched to Strava?

haystack_sessions.content: I finally set up my apartment in Oakland. The moving boxes are finally gone.
That is a great feeling! What did you do to celebrate finishing the move?
I just ordered takeout and watched a movie. Nothing fancy, but it felt earned.
Sometimes the quiet nights are the best reward after a big project. Enjoy the new place!
I have been logging my morning runs in Runkeeper and it has been going really well.
Nice streak! How far are you usually going on these morning runs?
About 5k every other day. Runkeeper tracks my pace and the route along the lake.
A lakeside 5k is a beautiful routine. Consistency like that builds up quickly.
I cancelled my Runkeeper subscription and switched everything over to Strava this week.
What made you switch to Strava after using Runkeeper for a while?
Most of my running club friends are on Strava, so the segments and club leaderboard were the pull.
Community is a strong motivator. Your running club will keep the streak alive on Strava.

haystack_sessions.content: My lease on the Honda Civic was up for renewal so I handed it back to the dealership last weekend.
Handing back a leased Civic is a clean exit. Are you planning to lease again or buy this time?
I have not decided yet. For now I am biking to work and taking the bus on rainy days.
That is a flexible way to test life without a car before committing to the next one.
I rented a Toyota Corolla for a trip to the mountains, but I returned it on Monday.
How was the Corolla on those mountain roads?
It handled the climbs fine, but I was glad to give the keys back and get back to the bus.
Sounds like the rental did its job for the trip without tempting you back into ownership.
